title: educabr2: Harmonized Historical Series on Brazilian Education
description:
R package with curated long-run series on Brazilian formal education: school enrollment (1871-2024), mean years of schooling (1925-2015), public expenditure on education (1933-2010), grade progression (1955-2010) and, for international comparison, educational attainment in 111 countries (1870-2010).

The series are compiled from official sources (INEP School Census, Higher Education Census and its Statistical Synopses; IBGE Statistical Yearbooks and Statistics of the 20th Century) and academic reconstructions (Kang, Paese and Felix 2021; Kang and Menetrier 2024; Kang, Menetrier and Comim 2024; Walter and Kang 2024; Maduro Junior 2007; Lee and Lee 2016), reconciled across sources and series breaks into one tidy schema in which every row records its source. The datasets are bundled with the package and work offline.

Cite this package for the harmonisation work and the original compilations for the underlying data (see educabr_cite()). Documentation: https://mancano-tales.github.io/educabr2/
